protocol.scope: Deterministic checkpoint-only terminal gradient identity check; no training or inference
protocol.states: All 120 selected original-bound Adam states (six rules by twenty seeds), plus twenty paired initial states
protocol.equation: exact terminal log-conductance gradient = kappa * augmented terminal log-conductance gradient
protocol.coordinates: Raw log-conductance gradients before clipping or optimizer transformation
protocol.examples: 512 frozen diagnostic examples per seed; loss normalized by variance of the 2048 training targets
protocol.tolerance: relative L2 residual <= 1e-10; all terminal kappa strictly positive
